scenes.headline: Again.
scenes.newInformation: The repeated search is the problem, not a missed application deadline.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Oversized duplicate search cards crowd the presenter; clearly labelled illustration.
scenes.transition: Cut closer to the search loop.

scenes.headline:
SAME SEARCH.
SAME SCROLL.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Close reaction shot; the mascot looks up at a recurring search card.
scenes.transition: Cut from a repeated card to a verified posting date.

scenes.headline: POSTED
scenes.newInformation: The actual captured listing is three days old, without calling it closed.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Large bold numeral with the real timestamp immediately underneath.
scenes.transition: The character asks a different question.

scenes.headline: What's new?
scenes.newInformation: The useful question is which roles are newer.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The mascot pushes the recurring search card off screen, making room for the question.
scenes.transition: Hard reset to an early brand introduction.

scenes.headline:
Meet
Solomon.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Large title, a single confident wave, no duplicate strapline.
scenes.transition: Presenter turns attention to real product criteria.

scenes.vo: Choose your field. Software engineering, for example.
scenes.headline: CHOOSE YOUR FIELD.
scenes.newInformation: Software Engineering is visibly selected in the recorded product.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The real occupation chip fills the frame above an attentive presenter.
scenes.transition: Match cut from the occupation chip to the Startup filter.

scenes.vo: Looking for startups? Narrow the feed.
scenes.headline: NARROW THE FEED.
scenes.newInformation: The same captured Startup selection changes the displayed result count.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Two large authentic crops change together, explicitly labelled before and after filtering.
scenes.transition: Hard cut to the actual resulting feed.

scenes.vo: Here's what the filtered feed looks like.
scenes.headline: YOUR FILTERED FEED.
scenes.newInformation: Show the recognizable application and the resulting listings, not a claim-bearing whole-screen crop.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The actual app gets the whole canvas for an establishing view.
scenes.transition: Reset with the character before another product concept.

captionPhrases.text: Here's what the filtered feed looks like.

scenes.headline:
LESS TO
SIFT THROUGH.
scenes.newInformation: The viewer has a narrower set to review.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A tight relaxed reaction shot breaks the proof-heavy sequence.
scenes.transition: The presenter redirects attention to a sorting control.

scenes.headline:
NEWEST
FIRST.
scenes.newInformation: Newest First is visibly selected in the actual product.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The real control occupies most of the middle frame; the hand and eyes arrive together.
scenes.transition: Cut from the ordering control into a listing.

scenes.vo: Read the role, then check its timestamp.
scenes.headline: READ THE ROLE.
scenes.newInformation: One genuine listing contains both a role name and a visible posting age.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Large product headline; an editorial underline moves from title to age as the voice directs it.
scenes.transition: Match cut from the source timestamp to an oversized number.

scenes.headline: POSTED
scenes.newInformation: This different archived listing says thirteen hours ago.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Same number layout as the opening, switching coral days to mint hours.
scenes.transition: Return to both original proof strips without changing either date.

scenes.headline: DIFFERENT JOBS.
scenes.newInformation: The two ages belong to different listings and different capture dates.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The older proof card slides away and a different recent listing replaces it on the spoken cue; each complete source strip holds still for reading.
scenes.transition: Presenter returns to the viewer for the caveat.

scenes.vo: Older doesn't mean closed. Check the date.
scenes.headline: OLDER ≠ CLOSED.
scenes.newInformation: A posting age is not evidence that applications have closed.
scenes.visualMetaphor: An open palm interrupts the false inference; plain sans type states the caveat.
scenes.transition: The caveat resolves into the opening-question callback.

scenes.vo: Next time, ask: what changed since I last checked?
scenes.headline: What changed?
scenes.newInformation: Replace repeated searching with a focused question about freshness.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The repeated search card exits; a large serif question takes its exact place.
scenes.transition: Cut straight to a short clean end card.

scenes.headline: Solomon.
scenes.newInformation: Close with the product name and no unverified link or automation promise.
scenes.visualMetaphor: One wordmark and one friendly gesture, no repeated payoff.
scenes.transition: Hold the brand to the final frame.
